name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

scoreThreshold.description: Omit all extracts with a score below this value. Currently, the prompt generates scores 0-10.

rankThreshold.description:
Omit all extracts that are ranked lower than this value.
Default is 0, which is interpreted as a request to skip truncation.

Ex. if set to 5, then only the top 5 ranked extracts will be even considered for question answering.
